sheet.div: ⏰ SNOOZED until . This item will not show as needing reorder until the snooze expires. Reason:
🕓 STALE DATA. The last analysis batch for this warehouse failed, so these numbers were left as-is instead of being refreshed or removed.
⚡ PROVISIONAL SUGGESTION. Stock went negative. Computed using emergency fallback. Run full analysis to replace with actual forecast.

✅ MARKED AS ORDERED by
on . Held off the next report; will resurface automatically if still needed after that.
Confirmed by:
To record who actually confirmed the order (if different from who clicked the button), add a note below in the log.
⚠️ NEGATIVE STOCK! On hand = units. Reorder immediately and ensure receipts are booked correctly.
💀 DEAD STOCK. No sales for months. Last sale: . Consider liquidating or returning to vendor.

🔧 LIKELY DATA ERROR, NOT A REAL SHORTFALL. On hand is negative but there's no real demand behind it (never sold, or not sold in longer than the Dead Stock Threshold) — this looks more like a data/timing issue (e.g. a delayed purchase receipt) than something worth ordering more of. Monthly sales, oldest → newest: . This module never adjusts stock itself — use the "🔧 Open Inventory Adjustment" button above to review and correct it in Odoo's own screen if that's the right call.
💰 This item exceeds the configured weekly budget cap. It is ranked # in priority order.
📋 DRAFT PO PENDING: . Reorder suggestions are held until it is confirmed or cancelled — see the Calculation Breakdown below for details.

⏳ STALE DRAFT PO:
has sat unconfirmed for
days. Confirm or cancel it — until then this suggestion stays held.
🔄 TRANSFER RECOMMENDED! Warehouse has surplus stock of this item. You can issue an internal transfer instead of an external PO. Estimated transfer lead time: days.

record.field: Everything currently flagged for attention, in one list — ranked by urgency first, then by how many separate things are flagged on it. An empty list means nothing needs a human look right now.
Suggestions that need reordering but have no vendor, or only a Temporary/Placeholder Vendor. Select rows and use "Bulk Assign Vendor" from the Action (⚙) menu to fix several at once.

Flagged Dead Stock AND showing Critical urgency at the same time — negative/promised stock is forcing a positive reorder qty on something that hasn't sold in months. Needs a human look before trusting the number: a real stock correction, a genuine reorder, or Snooze once resolved.

Negative stock with no real demand behind it — likely a data or timing error (e.g. a delayed purchase receipt), not a genuine reorder need. This list is read-only; nothing here writes to stock. Sorted oldest-last-sale-first. Use "Open Inventory Adjustment" on a row to review and correct it in Odoo's own screen if that's the right call.
